sql: SELECT "Invoice_Line_Items"."product_id" AS e, "Product_Categories"."product_type_description" AS g, AVG("Invoice_Line_Items"."derived_total_cost") AS m1, AVG(("Invoice_Line_Items"."derived_product_cost" - "Invoice_Line_Items"."product_price")) AS m2, (AVG("Invoice_Line_Items"."derived_total_cost") - AVG(("Invoice_Line_Items"."derived_product_cost" - "Invoice_Line_Items"."product_price"))) AS m3 FROM "Invoice_Line_Items" JOIN "Products" ON "Products"."product_id" = "Invoice_Line_Items"."product_id" JOIN "Product_Categories" ON "Product_Categories"."production_type_code" = "Products"."production_type_code" GROUP BY "Invoice_Line_Items"."product_id", "Product_Categories"."product_type_description" ORDER BY m3 DESC LIMIT 10
quantities: Invoice_Line_Items.line product cost minus product price per unit
why: average of line total cost including VAT per Products within Product_Categories.product_type_description
line product cost - product price per unit: both in USD and of the same kind (same additivity) on the same one product line on an invoice
average of line product cost minus product price per unit per Products within Product_Categories.product_type_description
average of line total cost including VAT minus average of line product cost minus product price per unit: both in USD, of the same kind, from different quantities

sql: SELECT "Invoice_Line_Items"."order_item_id" AS e, "Customers"."state_county_province" AS g, AVG("Invoice_Line_Items"."product_quantity") AS m1, AVG((CAST(("Invoice_Line_Items"."derived_total_cost" - "Invoice_Line_Items"."product_price") AS REAL) / "Invoice_Line_Items"."product_price")) AS m2 FROM "Invoice_Line_Items" JOIN "Order_Items" ON "Order_Items"."order_item_id" = "Invoice_Line_Items"."order_item_id" JOIN "Orders" ON "Orders"."order_id" = "Order_Items"."order_id" JOIN "Customers" ON "Customers"."customer_id" = "Orders"."customer_id" GROUP BY "Invoice_Line_Items"."order_item_id", "Customers"."state_county_province" ORDER BY m2 DESC LIMIT 10

why: average of units of product invoiced per Order_Items within Customers.state_county_province
(line total cost including VAT - product price per unit) / product price per unit: the relative difference of two quantities in USD
